readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with The Teacher Who Must Become Unnecessary and notice the promise it makes. Follow the audience through the inner laboratory, social relationships, inherited practices, and AI. The final constitution shows why those lessons belong to one argument. Its practical experiments ask readers to observe behavior and revise what fails. The book is for people seeking connection without turning their life into permanent performance. Its ending returns authority rather than asking you to reproduce the teacher’s identity. Read it to distinguish whose judgment deserves a hearing from whose reactions have taken control.
